code: Building or changing software. Includes tests-first (tdd-workflow), codebase-exploration, API & system design, stack patterns (Python/Go/Rust/React/…), databases and Docker/Kubernetes.
data: Working with data and judging AI output. Includes error-analysis, LLM-as-judge (write-judge-prompt + validate-evaluator), evaluate-rag, SQL, embeddings, vector search and statistics.
rag: Evaluating a RAG or retrieval agent. Includes evaluate-rag (scores search and answer separately), error-analysis, LLM judges, SQL checks and statistics.
pm: Product management. Includes PRDs (create-prd), product-vision, roadmaps, prioritization, user stories, GTM and competitor analysis.
security: Finding and fixing security problems. Includes the bb-methodology playbook, security-audit, the hunt-* vulnerability skills (SQLi/XSS/SSRF/RCE), vibesec (write secure code proactively), redteam-mindset and evidence hygiene.
ui: Building and polishing interfaces. Includes frontend-design, fixing-accessibility, design systems, motion, shadcn-ui and read-only improve-ui audits.
research: Investigate a topic and synthesize an answer (one-off, not filed into a vault). deep-research, research-synthesis, exa-search, x-research, search-first, defuddle. For a persistent knowledge base, use the knowledge mode instead.
ship-it: A quality gate to run before shipping. Includes code-review, verification-before-completion, security-audit, tests, clean-code habits, and ponytail (cut over-engineering).
quick-fix: Fast, focused debugging. Includes systematic-debugging (root cause first), caveman-debug (print statements) and error-handling.
declutter: Strip out over-engineering. The ponytail 'lazy senior engineer' skills — audit the repo for bloat, review a diff for what to delete, track deferred shortcuts — plus karpathy-guidelines and code-review.
writing: Everything for writing and editing prose. no-ai-slop (strip AI-slop / detect it), writing-skills, copywriting, article-writing, blog-post, content-creation & strategy, ux-copy, brand-voice, email (sequence + marketing), seo, report-writing, doc-coauthoring, documentation, kb-article, grammar-check and process-doc. Pick this for any docs, posts, or copy.
knowledge: Build and query a personal knowledge base — Andrej Karpathy's LLM-wiki pattern. The Obsidian stack: wiki (ingest/query/lint/fold), save insights, autoresearch into the vault, canvas, obsidian-cli, think, memory-gc. Pick this to compile knowledge you keep, not one-off answers.
